subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-continuity Skill Workshop updates override the default automatic approval policy and require an explicit one-time replacement confirmation?
rationale: This deliberately changes the operator workflow established by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107690; code review can verify implementation safety but cannot choose whether the extra approval is the intended permanent product policy.

options.title: Require replacement confirmation
options.body: Keep automatic approval for substantially continuous edits, but require an explicit one-time confirmation for low-continuity replacements and enforce it at the shared apply boundary.

options.title: Keep unconditional automatic approval
options.body: Reject invalid or incomplete SKILL.md bodies, but allow every structurally valid replacement to follow the existing automatic approval policy.

options.title: Gate every update
options.body: Require approval for all Skill Workshop updates, trading simpler safety semantics for a broader workflow regression.

recommendation.title: Require replacement confirmation
recommendation.body: Keep automatic approval for substantially continuous edits, but require an explicit one-time confirmation for low-continuity replacements and enforce it at the shared apply boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the automatic approval default whose semantics the PR conditionally changes.
